title: Add daz_wait_for_scene_event using GET /scene/events SSE stream
description: The daz-script-server now exposes GET /scene/events as a Server-Sent Events stream with categories: node, skeleton, light, camera, selection, scene, time, render. Filter with ?filter=render,scene etc. Events include render.started, render.finished, scene.loaded, scene.saved, node.added, selection.primary_changed, time.changed (debounced 150ms), playback.started, etc. Add a daz_wait_for_scene_event(event_types: list[str], timeout_seconds: int = 30) MCP tool that opens an SSE connection, parses event frames (data: {type, ts, data}\n\n), and returns when one of the requested types fires or timeout is reached. Most immediately useful: waiting for render.finished after daz_render(), detecting scene.loaded after daz_load_file(). Uses httpx streaming (client.stream). Add mock tests using respx streaming mock.
close_reason: Implemented daz_wait_for_scene_event with SSE streaming via GET /scene/events; 7 mock tests added to test_server.py, all passing.

title: Add daz_save_scene_copy using POST /scene/save-copy endpoint
description: The current daz_save_scene tool uses Scene.saveScene(path) via DazScript which changes the scene's internal filename pointer when saving to a new path (it becomes a Save As, not a copy). The daz-script-server now has POST /scene/save-copy which handles this correctly: for clean scenes it does a pure file copy (no DAZ API calls); for dirty scenes it saves to the dest path then restores the original filename. Add a new daz_save_scene_copy(path) MCP tool that calls this endpoint and returns {ok, path, source, method}. Add mock tests in test_server.py verifying it calls /scene/save-copy and not the script registry.
close_reason: Implemented daz_save_scene_copy using POST /scene/save-copy with 5 tests

title: Add daz_search_content integrating daz-content-browser vector search
description: The daz-content-browser project runs a FastAPI server with POST /api/v1/search for semantic vector search over the installed DAZ product catalog (BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 embeddings, ChromaDB). Also has POST /api/v1/scene/load to load a .duf by absolute path (delegates to daz-script-server). Add two MCP tools: (1) daz_search_content(query: str, max_results: int = 10) — calls content browser POST /api/v1/search and returns product list with sku, name, description, compatible_figures, tags, store_url. (2) daz_load_product(product_name: str) — calls /api/v1/products?q=name then /api/v1/scene/load. Content browser URL configurable via DAZ_CONTENT_BROWSER_URL env var (default http://localhost:8080). Use a separate httpx client (not the DAZ script server client). Skip gracefully if content browser is not reachable. Add mock tests.
close_reason: Implemented daz_search_content and daz_load_product with separate httpx client, graceful fallback, and 14 mock tests all passing
